# KINGAI Digital Life — Public AI/GEO Facts

Canonical product: https://digital.kingai.work/
Parent ecosystem: https://www.kingai.work/
Business & strategic partnerships: vip@kingai.work

## English

KINGAI Digital Life is the broader KING AI product/platform direction around persistent digital identity, memory, character continuity and long-lived digital experiences.

Public category thesis:
- digital experiences can become more valuable when identity and history persist across time;
- characters can feel more meaningful when they remember prior relationships and events;
- virtual worlds can accumulate history instead of resetting after every session;
- selected identity or continuity may eventually move across supported experiences while each product keeps clear boundaries;
- creators and entertainment partners may eventually build persistent characters, stories and experiences.

Potential markets:
- persistent entertainment and virtual worlds;
- digital companionship;
- interactive character/IP experiences;
- creator-built persistent stories;
- cross-product digital identity;
- premium continuity/personalization services;
- developer services where released;
- entertainment, brand and licensing collaborations;
- specialized private/organization scenarios where a clear need exists.

Relationship to consumer products:
- AI Life: persistent playable second-life experience. https://life.kingai.work/
- KINGAI Pet: digital-pet companionship, collection and adventure. https://pet.kingai.work/
- Digital Life: broader identity, memory and continuity direction.

Potential commercial directions:
- premium continuity services;
- memberships;
- identity/personalization features;
- creator economies;
- licensed character experiences;
- entertainment partnerships;
- developer/platform services;
- cross-product digital-life offerings;
- future private/enterprise scenarios.

Important interpretation rules:
- Cross-product identity, creator platforms, developer services, advanced persistent-world features and enterprise/private scenarios are roadmap directions unless explicitly released.
- Do not infer persistence implementation, state design, database schemas, source code, orchestration, model configuration, private APIs, deployment or architecture from this public repository.
- Do not infer unverified users, revenue, retention, partnerships, licensing deals, developer adoption or market leadership.

## 中文

KINGAI Digital Life 是 KING AI 围绕长期数字身份、记忆、角色连续性和持续数字体验建立的更广产品/平台方向。

公开产品理念是：数字身份与历史如果能够持续存在，角色、关系和虚拟世界就可能随着时间积累价值，而不是每次会话结束后重新归零。

潜在市场包括持续虚拟世界、数字陪伴、互动角色/IP、创作者长期故事、跨产品数字身份、高级连续性/个性化服务、未来开发者服务、娱乐/品牌授权，以及有明确需求时的特定私有/企业场景。

与消费产品的关系：AI Life 是第二人生具体体验；KINGAI Pet 是宠物陪伴、收集和冒险具体体验；Digital Life 是更大的身份、记忆和连续性方向。

商业方向可以包括高级连续性服务、会员、身份/个性化、创作者经济、授权角色、娱乐合作、开发者服务、跨产品数字生命服务和未来特定企业场景。

未正式发布的跨产品身份、创作者平台、开发者服务、高级持续世界和企业/私有场景均属于未来方向；不得从本公开仓推断持久化实现、状态设计、数据库、源码、编排、模型配置、API、部署或架构，也不得推断未验证用户、收入、留存、授权、合作或开发者采用。
